scripts.summary: Auto Player for Symphony Ochestra.
scripts.code:
if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    local btn = Instance.new('TextButton')
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 8)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = 'Autoplay: OFF'
    btn.Parent = gui
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not state.enabled)
        btn.Text = 'Autoplay: ' .. (state.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    end)
    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI unavailable, using fallback toggle')
end

local windOk = pcall(function()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua'))()
    assert(typeof(WindUI) == 'table' and WindUI.CreateWindow, 'WindUI load failed')

    local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Folder = 'SymphonyAutoplay',
        OpenButton = { Enabled = true, Title = 'Symphony Autoplay' },
    })
    state.win = Window

    local Tab = Window:Tab({ Title = 'Autoplay', Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone' })
    Tab:Toggle({
        Title = 'Autoplay Notes',
        Desc = 'Hits every note perfectly - holds included. Start any song and watch it play itself.',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            setEnabled(v)
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
                Content = v and 'Enabled - start or keep playing a song.' or 'Disabled.',
                Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    })

    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Content = engine and 'Engine hooked - ready to play.' or ('Hook failed: ' .. tostring(resolveErr)),
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Duration = 5,
    })
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI ready')
end)

if not windOk then fallbackGui() end

scripts.code:
-- Invisible World Platform Walk Script + Up/Down Speed Controls (Mobile + PC)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local oldGui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("PlatformWalkGui") or playerGui:FindFirstChild("PlatformWalkGui")
if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end

local state = {
	enabled = false,
	walkSpeed = 28,
	upSpeed = 24,
	downSpeed = 24,
	platformY = nil,
	moveUp = false,
	moveDown = false,
	pinned = false,
	minimized = false
}

local platformPart = nil
local originalWalkSpeed = nil

local function getCharacterParts()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return nil end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return nil end
	return char, hum, root
end

local function destroyPlatform()
	if platformPart then
		platformPart:Destroy()
		platformPart = nil
	end
end

local function createPlatform(x, y, z)
	destroyPlatform()

	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "WorldHoverPlatform"
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = true
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(4096, 4, 4096)
	part.Position = Vector3.new(x, y, z)
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth

	local parentOk = pcall(function()
		part.Parent = workspace
	end)
	if not parentOk then
		part.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Folder") or workspace
	end

	platformPart = part
	return part
end

local function getFeetLevel(hum, root)
	local hipOffset = (hum and hum.HipHeight > 0 and hum.HipHeight or 2) + (root.Size.Y * 0.5)
	return root.Position.Y - hipOffset - (platformPart and (platformPart.Size.Y * 0.5) or 2)
end

local function setMode(active)
	state.enabled = active
	local char, hum, root = getCharacterParts()

	if active then
		if hum then
			originalWalkSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
			hum.WalkSpeed = state.walkSpeed
		end
		if root then
			local centerY = getFeetLevel(hum, root)
			state.platformY = centerY
			createPlatform(root.Position.X, centerY, root.Position.Z)
		end
	else
		state.moveUp = false
		state.moveDown = false
		state.platformY = nil
		destroyPlatform()
		if hum and originalWalkSpeed then
			hum.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed
		end
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	state.enabled = false
	state.moveUp = false
	state.moveDown = false
	state.platformY = nil
	destroyPlatform()
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if hum then
		originalWalkSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if not state.enabled then return end

	local char, hum, root = getCharacterParts()
	if not root or not hum then
		setMode(false)
		return
	end

	if hum.WalkSpeed ~= state.walkSpeed then
		hum.WalkSpeed = state.walkSpeed
	end

	if not platformPart or platformPart.Parent == nil then
		local centerY = state.platformY or getFeetLevel(hum, root)
		createPlatform(root.Position.X, centerY, root.Position.Z)
	end

	if state.platformY == nil then
		state.platformY = getFeetLevel(hum, root)
	end

	local deltaY = 0
	if state.moveUp and not state.moveDown then
		deltaY = state.upSpeed * dt
	elseif state.moveDown and not state.moveUp then
		deltaY = -state.downSpeed * dt
	end

	if deltaY ~= 0 then
		state.platformY += deltaY
		root.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, deltaY, 0)
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
	end

	platformPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, state.platformY, root.Position.Z)
end)

-- ==================== GUI ====================
local FULL_HEIGHT = 242
local MIN_HEIGHT = 28

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "PlatformWalkGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

local parentOk = pcall(function()
	screenGui.Parent = CoreGui
end)
if not parentOk then
	screenGui.Parent = playerGui
end

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 232, 0, FULL_HEIGHT)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.22, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 16)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = mainFrame

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 52)
stroke.Thickness = 1
stroke.Parent = mainFrame

local topBar = Instance.new("Frame")
topBar.Name = "TopBar"
topBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, MIN_HEIGHT)
topBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26)
topBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
topBar.Parent = mainFrame

local topCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
topCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
topCorner.Parent = topBar

local topFix = Instance.new("Frame")
topFix.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8)
topFix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -8)
topFix.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26)
topFix.BorderSizePixel = 0
topFix.Parent = topBar

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 1, 0)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.Text = "Платформа / Platform Fly"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
titleLabel.TextSize = 12
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleLabel.Parent = topBar

local function makeHeaderBtn(text, offsetX, bgColor)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 20)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, offsetX, 0.5, -10)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = bgColor or Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 40)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
	btn.TextSize = 11
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.Parent = topBar

	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
	c.Parent = btn
	return btn
end

local closeBtn = makeHeaderBtn("×", -25, Color3.fromRGB(110, 28, 34))
local minBtn = makeHeaderBtn("-", -49)
local pinBtn = makeHeaderBtn("📌", -73)

local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos

topBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if state.pinned then return end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and not state.pinned then
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

local bodyFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
bodyFrame.Name = "BodyFrame"
bodyFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -36)
bodyFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 32)
bodyFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bodyFrame.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 38)
toggleBtn.Text = "Режим: ВЫКЛ / OFF"
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
toggleBtn.TextSize = 12
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleBtn.Parent = bodyFrame

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

local function refreshToggleVisual()
	if state.enabled then
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 110, 62)
		toggleBtn.Text = "Режим: ВКЛ / ON"
	else
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 38)
		toggleBtn.Text = "Режим: ВЫКЛ / OFF"
	end
end

toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setMode(not state.enabled)
	refreshToggleVisual()
end)

local function createSpeedRow(labelText, posY, defaultValue, onCommit)
	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.62, 0, 0, 24)
	lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, posY)

	local box = Instance.new("TextBox")

	box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 29)

	box.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	box.TextSize = 12
	box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.BorderSizePixel = 0

    pcall(env.AntiBackshotUnload)
end

local FILE = "AntiBackshot_Settings.json"

local Config = {
    Enabled = false,
    ShowBox = true,
    BoxSize = 12,
    BoxHeight = 7,
    PushSpeed = 65,
    Cooldown = 0.4,
    ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.K
}

--// Load saved settings
local function LoadSettings()
    local data

    if type(isfile) == "function"
        and type(readfile) == "function"
        and isfile(FILE) then

        local success, result = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(FILE))
        end)

        if success and type(result) == "table" then
            data = result
        end
    elseif type(env.AntiBackshotSettings) == "table" then
        data = env.AntiBackshotSettings
    end

    if not data then return end

    for key, default in pairs(Config) do
        if type(data[key]) == type(default) then
            if key == "BoxSize" then
                Config[key] = math.clamp(data[key], 4, 30)
            elseif key == "PushSpeed" then
                Config[key] = math.clamp(data[key], 10, 150)
            elseif key ~= "ToggleKey" then
                Config[key] = data[key]
            end
        end
    end
end

LoadSettings()

local function SaveSettings()
    local data = {
        Enabled = Config.Enabled,
        ShowBox = Config.ShowBox,
        BoxSize = Config.BoxSize,
        BoxHeight = Config.BoxHeight,
        PushSpeed = Config.PushSpeed,
        Cooldown = Config.Cooldown
    }

    env.AntiBackshotSettings = data

    if type(writefile) == "function" then

    local Row = New("Frame", {

        BorderSizePixel = 0
    }, Content)

    New("TextLabel", {

        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = name,
        TextColor3 = WHITE,
        TextSize = 13,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    }, Row)

    local Button = New("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(65, 28),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0.5, -14),
        BackgroundColor3 = PANEL,
        Text = "",
        BorderSizePixel = 0
    }, Row)
    Corner(Button, 14)

    local Knob = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4),
        BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
        BorderSizePixel = 0
    }, Button)
    Corner(Knob, 10)

    local enabled = initial

    local function Render()
        TweenService:Create(
            Button,
            TweenInfo.new(0.16),
            {
                BackgroundColor3 = enabled and RED
                    or Color3.fromRGB(64, 65, 77)
            }
        ):Play()

        TweenService:Create(
            Knob,
            TweenInfo.new(0.16),
            {
                Position = enabled
                    and UDim2.fromOffset(41, 4)
                    or UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)
            }
        ):Play()
    end

    Connect(Button.MouseButton1Click, function()
        enabled = not enabled
        Render()
        callback(enabled)
    end)

    Render()

    return function(value)
        enabled = value
        Render()
        callback(enabled)
    end
end

--// Slider creator
local function MakeSlider(
    name, order, minValue, maxValue, default, callback
)
    local Row = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 65),
        BackgroundColor3 = PANEL,
        LayoutOrder = order,
        BorderSizePixel = 0
    }, Content)
    Corner(Row, 9)

    New("TextLabel", {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 8),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 18),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = name,
        TextColor3 = WHITE,
        TextSize = 13,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    }, Row)

    local Value = New("TextLabel", {
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -73, 0, 8),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 18),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = tostring(default),
        TextColor3 = RED,
        TextSize = 13,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    }, Row)

    local Track = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 6),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 43),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 62, 75),
        BorderSizePixel = 0
    }, Row)
    Corner(Track, 3)

    local fraction = (default - minValue) / (maxValue - minValue)

    local Fill = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = RED,
        BorderSizePixel = 0
    }, Track)
    Corner(Fill, 3)

    local Knob = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 0.5),
        BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
        BorderSizePixel = 0
    }, Track)
    Corner(Knob, 7)

    local dragging = false

    local function Update(x)
        local percent = math.clamp(
            (x - Track.AbsolutePosition.X)
            / math.max(Track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1),
            0, 1
        )

        local amount = math.floor(
            minValue + (maxValue - minValue) * percent + 0.5
        )

        Value.Text = tostring(amount)
        Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(percent, 1)
        Knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(percent, 0.5)

        callback(amount)
    end

    local Hitbox = New("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -12),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = ""
    }, Track)

    Connect(Hitbox.InputBegan, function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            Update(input.Position.X)

    Connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)

--// Character handling
local function SetupCharacter(character)
    Root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
    LastPush = 0
end

if Player.Character then
    task.spawn(SetupCharacter, Player.Character)

--// Player detection
local function IsInside(otherRoot)
    if not Root then return false end

    local relative = Root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(
        otherRoot.Position
    )

    return math.abs(relative.X) <= Config.BoxSize / 2
        and math.abs(relative.Y) <= Config.BoxHeight / 2
        and math.abs(relative.Z) <= Config.BoxSize / 2
end

--// Retreat from nearby player
local function Retreat(otherRoot)
    if not Root or not Root.Parent then return end

    local humanoid =
        Root.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local diff = Root.Position - otherRoot.Position
    local direction = Vector3.new(diff.X, 0, diff.Z)

    if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        local back = -Root.CFrame.LookVector
        direction = Vector3.new(back.X, 0, back.Z)
    end

    if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        direction = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    end

    direction = direction.Unit

    local y = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y

    Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
        direction.X * Config.PushSpeed,
        y,
        direction.Z * Config.PushSpeed
    )
end

--// Main protection loop
Connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
    if not Running then return end

    if Root and Root.Parent then
        Box.CFrame = Root.CFrame
    end

    if not Config.Enabled or not Root or not Root.Parent then
        return
    end

    LastScan = LastScan + dt

    if LastScan < 0.05 then return end
    LastScan = 0

    if os.clock() - LastPush < Config.Cooldown then
        return
    end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= Player and player.Character then
            local character = player.Character
            local otherRoot =
                character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid =
                character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if otherRoot and humanoid
                and humanoid.Health > 0
                and IsInside(otherRoot) then

                Retreat(otherRoot)
                LastPush = os.clock()
                break
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Volley Bomb | Ball Trajectory Script - by Fyye_Hub

local Workspace  = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local SKINS = {
    ["Ice Ball"]=true, ["Galaxy Ball"]=true, ["Beach Ball"]=true, ["Volleyball"]=true,
    ["Basketball"]=true, ["Evidence Ball"]=true, ["Football"]=true, ["Bowling Ball"]=true,
    ["Redacted Ball"]=true, ["Smokescreen Ball"]=true, ["Target Ball"]=true, ["Aurora Ball"]=true,
    ["Deadeye Ball"]=true, ["Golden Ball"]=true, ["Laserline Ball"]=true, ["Volcanic Ball"]=true,
    ["Afterimage Ball"]=true, ["Cannonball"]=true, ["Dragon Ball"]=true, ["Operative Ball"]=true,
    ["Circuit Rush"]=true, ["Imperial Weave"]=true, ["Prism Strike"]=true, ["Redline Core Ball"]=true,
    ["Tidal Crest"]=true, ["Default"]=true, ["Ball"]=true
}

local BALL_RADIUS      = 1.5
local MARKER_DIAMETER  = 3.6
local MARKER_THICK     = 0.16
local WALL_RESTITUTION = 0.82
local MOVE_EPS         = 0.012
local TELEPORT_JUMP    = 50
local BOUNCE_VY        = 3.2
local STICK_STUDS      = 2.0
local RAY_REFRESH      = 12
local MIN_SPEED        = 0.6
local DESCEND_VY       = -0.5
local LERP_SPEED       = 12
local STEP_DT          = 1/140
local MAX_STEPS        = 520
local MAX_BOUNCES      = 4

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))
folder.Parent = Workspace

local ballData = {}

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true

local rayTick = 0
local function refreshRayIgnore()
    local ignore = {folder}
    for _, c in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if c.Name == "BallShadow" or (SKINS[c.Name] and (c:IsA("BasePart") or c:IsA("MeshPart"))) then
            table.insert(ignore, c)
        end
    end
    for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if pl.Character then table.insert(ignore, pl.Character) end
    end
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
end
refreshRayIgnore()

local function isBall(o)
    if not o or not o.Parent then return false end
    if o.Name == "BallShadow" then return false end
    if o.Parent ~= Workspace then return false end
    return SKINS[o.Name] and (o:IsA("BasePart") or o:IsA("MeshPart"))
end

local function createMarker()
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = "x"..math.random(10000, 99999)
    p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    p.Size = Vector3.new(MARKER_THICK, MARKER_DIAMETER, MARKER_DIAMETER)
    p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 25, 25)
    p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    p.Anchored = true
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.CanQuery = false
    p.CanTouch = false
    p.CastShadow = false
    p.Transparency = 1
    p.Parent = folder
    return p
end

local function getData(ball)
    if not ballData[ball] then
        ballData[ball] = {
            marker = createMarker(),
            history = {},
            lastLanding = nil,
            displayed = nil,
            locked = nil,
            lockUntil = 0
        }
    end
    return ballData[ball]
end

local function destroyData(ball)
    local d = ballData[ball]
    if d then
        if d.marker then d.marker:Destroy() end
        ballData[ball] = nil
    end
end

local function getGroundY(atXZ)
    local origin = Vector3.new(atXZ.X, 220, atXZ.Z)
    local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -450, 0), rayParams)
    if hit then
        return hit.Position.Y + BALL_RADIUS
    end
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hrp then
            local hip = hum and hum.HipHeight or 2
            return (hrp.Position.Y - 0.5*hrp.Size.Y - hip) + BALL_RADIUS
        end
    end
    return 29
end

local function pushSample(d, ball)
    local now = tick()
    local pos = ball.Position
    local hist = d.history
    local n = #hist
    if n > 0 then
        local last = hist[n]
        local dp = (pos - last.p).Magnitude
        if dp < MOVE_EPS and (now - last.t) < 0.07 then return end
        if dp > TELEPORT_JUMP then
            d.history = {}
            d.lastLanding = nil
            d.displayed = nil
            d.locked = nil
            d.lockUntil = 0
            return
        end
    end
    if n >= 3 then
        local a, b, c = hist[n-2], hist[n-1], hist[n]
        local dt1 = b.t - a.t
        local dt2 = c.t - b.t
        if dt1 > 1e-5 and dt2 > 1e-5 then
            local vy1 = (b.p.Y - a.p.Y) / dt1
            local vy2 = (c.p.Y - b.p.Y) / dt2
            if vy1 < -BOUNCE_VY and vy2 > BOUNCE_VY then
                d.history = {c}
                d.lastLanding = nil
                d.displayed = nil
                d.locked = nil
                d.lockUntil = 0
            end
        end
    end
    table.insert(hist, {t = now, p = pos})
    while #hist > 1 and now - hist[1].t > 0.22 do table.remove(hist, 1) end
    while #hist > 16 do table.remove(hist, 1) end
end

local function getVelocity(d, ball)
    local av = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    if av and av.Magnitude > 0.15 then
        return av
    end
    local hist = d.history
    local n = #hist
    if n < 2 then return nil end
    local use = math.min(n, 3)
    local start = n - use + 1
    local tM = 0
    for i = start, n do tM = tM + hist[i].t end
    tM = tM / use
    local sx, sy, sz, stt = 0, 0, 0, 0
    for i = start, n do
        local dt = hist[i].t - tM
        sx = sx + dt * hist[i].p.X
        sy = sy + dt * hist[i].p.Y
        sz = sz + dt * hist[i].p.Z
        stt = stt + dt * dt
    end
    if stt < 1e-8 then return nil end
    return Vector3.new(sx/stt, sy/stt, sz/stt)
end

local function reflect(vel, normal)
    return vel - 2 * vel:Dot(normal) * normal
end

local function simulateLanding(startPos, startVel)
    local g = Workspace.Gravity
    local p = startPos
    local v = startVel
    local bounces = 0
    local groundY = getGroundY(startPos)

    for i = 1, MAX_STEPS do
        local nextV = v + Vector3.new(0, -g, 0) * STEP_DT
        local nextP = p + v * STEP_DT + Vector3.new(0, -0.5 * g * STEP_DT * STEP_DT, 0)

        local delta = nextP - p
        if delta.Magnitude > 0.04 then
            local hit = Workspace:Raycast(p, delta, rayParams)
            if hit then
                local n = hit.Normal
                if math.abs(n.Y) < 0.7 then
                    if bounces >= MAX_BOUNCES then
                        local land = hit.Position + n * 1.4
                        return Vector3.new(land.X, getGroundY(land), land.Z)
                    end
                    p = hit.Position + n * 0.15
                    v = reflect(v, n) * WALL_RESTITUTION
                    bounces = bounces + 1
                elseif n.Y > 0.55 then
                    return Vector3.new(hit.Position.X, hit.Position.Y + BALL_RADIUS, hit.Position.Z)
                else
                    local land = hit.Position + n * 1.2
                    return Vector3.new(land.X, getGroundY(land), land.Z)
                end
            else
                p = nextP
                v = nextV
            end
        else
            p = nextP
            v = nextV
        end

        if p.Y <= groundY + 0.2 and v.Y < DESCEND_VY then
            return Vector3.new(p.X, groundY, p.Z)
        end
    end
    return Vector3.new(p.X, getGroundY(p), p.Z)
end

local function updateBall(ball, dt)
    local d = getData(ball)
    pushSample(d, ball)

    local vel = getVelocity(d, ball)
    if not vel or vel.Magnitude < MIN_SPEED then
        d.marker.Transparency = 1
        return
    end

    local landing = simulateLanding(ball.Position, vel)
    if not landing then
        d.marker.Transparency = 1
        return
    end

    local now = tick()
    if d.locked and now < d.lockUntil then
        if (landing - d.locked).Magnitude < STICK_STUDS * 1.5 then
            landing = d.locked
        else
            d.locked = landing
            d.lockUntil = now + 0.14
        end
    else
        if d.lastLanding and (landing - d.lastLanding).Magnitude < STICK_STUDS then
            landing = d.lastLanding
            d.locked = landing
            d.lockUntil = now + 0.16
        else
            d.locked = landing
            d.lockUntil = now + 0.09
        end
    end
    d.lastLanding = landing

    if not d.displayed then
        d.displayed = landing
    else
        d.displayed = d.displayed:Lerp(landing, math.clamp(LERP_SPEED * dt, 0, 1))
    end

    d.marker.CFrame = CFrame.new(d.displayed) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
    d.marker.Transparency = 0.32
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    rayTick = rayTick + 1
    if rayTick >= RAY_REFRESH then refreshRayIgnore(); rayTick = 0 end

    local alive = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if isBall(c) then
            alive[c] = true
            updateBall(c, dt)
        end
    end

    for ball in pairs(ballData) do
        if not alive[ball] or not ball.Parent then

scripts.code:
--[[
    Delta Executor — Universal Combat & Movement Script
    Функции: Target Aimbot (Wall Check), ESP, Speed Hack, Infinite Jump, Noclip
    Зависимость: Rayfield UI (загружается автоматически)
--]]

-- // Загрузка UI-библиотеки Rayfield
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

-- // Сервисы
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- // Состояния
local AimbotEnabled = false
local WallCheckEnabled = true
local ESPEnabled = false
local SpeedHackEnabled = false
local InfJumpEnabled = false
local NoclipEnabled = false
local AimbotFOV = 120
local AimbotSmoothness = 0.15
local ESPColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)

-- // Хранилище ESP-объектов
local espObjects = {}

-- // Окно Rayfield
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Delta Combat & Movement",
    LoadingTitle = "Загрузка...",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by AI",
    ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
    KeySystem = false
})

-- // Вкладка Aimbot
local AimbotTab = Window:CreateTab("Aimbot", nil)

AimbotTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Включить Aimbot",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "AimbotToggle",
    Callback = function(value)
        AimbotEnabled = value
    end
})

AimbotTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Проверка стен (Wall Check)",
    CurrentValue = true,
    Flag = "WallCheckToggle",
    Callback = function(value)
        WallCheckEnabled = value
    end
})

AimbotTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "FOV (радиус наведения)",
    Range = { 40, 360 },
    Increment = 10,
    Suffix = "°",
    CurrentValue = 120,
    Flag = "FOVSlider",
    Callback = function(value)
        AimbotFOV = value
    end
})

AimbotTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Плавность (0 = мгновенно)",
    Range = { 0, 1 },
    Increment = 0.05,
    Suffix = "",
    CurrentValue = 0.15,
    Flag = "SmoothSlider",
    Callback = function(value)
        AimbotSmoothness = value
    end
})

-- // Вкладка ESP
local ESPTab = Window:CreateTab("ESP", nil)

ESPTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Включить ESP",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "ESPToggle",
    Callback = function(value)
        ESPEnabled = value
        if value then
            -- Принудительно обновляем ESP для всех текущих игроков
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                    pcall(function() applyESP(plr) end)
                end
            end
        else
            -- Удаляем все ESP-объекты
            for plr, obj in pairs(espObjects) do
                if obj and obj.Destroy then obj:Destroy() end
                espObjects[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end
})

-- // Вкладка Movement
local MoveTab = Window:CreateTab("Movement", nil)

MoveTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Speed Hack",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "SpeedToggle",
    Callback = function(value)
        SpeedHackEnabled = value
        if not value then
            -- Возвращаем стандартную скорость
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").WalkSpeed = 16
            end
        end
    end
})

MoveTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Скорость ходьбы",
    Range = { 16, 300 },
    Increment = 5,
    Suffix = "",
    CurrentValue = 50,
    Flag = "SpeedSlider",
    Callback = function(value)
        if SpeedHackEnabled then
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").WalkSpeed = value
            end
        end
    end
})

MoveTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Infinite Jump",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "InfJumpToggle",
    Callback = function(value)
        InfJumpEnabled = value
    end
})

MoveTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Noclip",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "NoclipToggle",
    Callback = function(value)
        NoclipEnabled = value
        if not value then
            -- Возвращаем коллизии при выключении
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
})

-- // ========== РЕАЛИЗАЦИЯ ФУНКЦИЙ ==========

-- // ESP
local function applyESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    if not player.Character then return end

    -- Удаляем старый ESP, если есть
    if espObjects[player] then
        espObjects[player]:Destroy()
        espObjects[player] = nil
    end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "DeltaESP"
    highlight.FillColor = ESPColor
    highlight.OutlineColor = ESPColor
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.7
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Adornee = player.Character
    highlight.Parent = player.Character

    espObjects[player] = highlight
end

-- // Обработка появления/удаления игроков
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    if ESPEnabled then
        applyESP(player)
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if ESPEnabled then
            task.wait(0.5) -- Небольшая задержка, чтобы персонаж успел загрузиться
            applyESP(player)
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
        onPlayerAdded(plr)
    end
end

-- // Noclip
local function noclipCharacter()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
end

-- // Infinite Jump
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if InfJumpEnabled then
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end)

-- // Aimbot с проверкой стен
local function getClosestTarget()
    local closest = nil
    local shortestDist = math.huge
    local screenCenter = Camera.ViewportSize / 2

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then continue end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not head or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end

        local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
        if not onScreen then continue end

        local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
        if dist > AimbotFOV then continue end

        if WallCheckEnabled then
            local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
            rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character, player.Character }
            rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
            local direction = (head.Position - origin)
            local rayResult = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, rayParams)
            if rayResult then
                -- Есть препятствие — цель не видна
                continue
            end
        end

        if dist < shortestDist then
            shortestDist = dist
            closest = player
        end
    end
    return closest
end

-- // Основной цикл
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    -- Aimbot
    if AimbotEnabled then
        local target = getClosestTarget()
        if target and target.Character then
            local targetHead = target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if targetHead then
                local targetPos = targetHead.Position
                local currentCFrame = Camera.CFrame
                local desiredCFrame = CFrame.new(currentCFrame.Position, targetPos)
                if AimbotSmoothness > 0 then
                    Camera.CFrame = currentCFrame:Lerp(desiredCFrame, AimbotSmoothness)
                else
                    Camera.CFrame = desiredCFrame
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Speed Hack (постоянно обновляем, чтобы не сбрасывалось)
    if SpeedHackEnabled then
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                -- Значение берётся из слайдера (сохраняется в переменной через замыкание)
                -- Для простоты используем 50, но можно вынести в переменную.
                -- В реальном скрипте лучше хранить текущее значение слайдера.
                hum.WalkSpeed = 50
            end
        end
    end

    -- Noclip
    if NoclipEnabled then
        noclipCharacter()
    end
end)

scripts.summary: chukunhax, keyless , open source auto throw throw perfect fast throw throw foods at animals / throw foods for animals auto farm easy xeno solara
scripts.code:
getgenv().chukunhax = {
	autothrow = true,
	perfectthrow = true,
	fastthrow = true,
	fastspeed = 3,
}

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if type(env.chukunhax_stop) == "function" then pcall(env.chukunhax_stop) end

local chukunhax = env.chukunhax or {}
env.chukunhax = chukunhax
for key, value in pairs({ autothrow = false, perfectthrow = false, fastthrow = false, fastspeed = 3 }) do
	if chukunhax[key] == nil then chukunhax[key] = value end
end

local token = {}
env.chukunhax_token = token
local undo = {}
local function alive() return env.chukunhax_token == token end

env.chukunhax_stop = function()
	env.chukunhax_token = nil
	for i = #undo, 1, -1 do pcall(undo[i]) end
end

local lp = players.LocalPlayer
local function load(inst)
	local ok, module = pcall(require, inst)
	return ok and module or nil
end

local controllers = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("Client"):WaitForChild("Controllers")
local shared = rs:WaitForChild("Shared")
local state = load(controllers:WaitForChild("ClientState"))
local meter = load(controllers:WaitForChild("ThrowMeter"))
local game_config = load(rs:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local meter_math = load(shared:WaitForChild("ThrowMeterMath"))
local arc = load(shared:WaitForChild("ProjectileMath"))
local anim = load(shared:WaitForChild("AnimationLibrary"))

local function speed()
	return chukunhax.fastspeed * (0.94 + math.random() * 0.12)
end

local function character()
	local char = lp.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then return char, root, hum end
end

local function loop(delay, fn)
	task.spawn(function()
		while alive() do
			pcall(fn)
			task.wait(delay)
		end
	end)
end

local orig_arc = arc and arc.CreateArc
if orig_arc then
	arc.CreateArc = function(a, b, time, ...)
		if chukunhax.fastthrow and type(time) == "number" then
			time = math.max(0.35, time / speed())
		end
		return orig_arc(a, b, time, ...)
	end
	undo[#undo + 1] = function() arc.CreateArc = orig_arc end
end

local orig_play = anim and anim.Play
if orig_play then
	anim.Play = function(rig, id, ...)
		local track = orig_play(rig, id, ...)
		if chukunhax.fastthrow and track and id == anim.GetThrowId() then
			pcall(track.AdjustSpeed, track, speed())
		end
		return track
	end
	undo[#undo + 1] = function() anim.Play = orig_play end
end

local sequence_keys = { "FadeIn", "FadeOut", "POVDuration", "RevealZoomNormal", "RevealZoomDramatic", "ShowTimeNormal", "ShowTimeShort", "SkipAfterRevealDelay" }
local sequence_original

local function sync_sequence()
	local sequence = game_config and game_config.Sequence
	if not sequence then return end
	if not sequence_original then
		sequence_original = {}
		for _, key in ipairs(sequence_keys) do sequence_original[key] = sequence[key] end
		undo[#undo + 1] = function()
			for key, value in pairs(sequence_original) do sequence[key] = value end
		end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(sequence_keys) do
		if sequence_original[key] then
			sequence[key] = chukunhax.fastthrow and math.max(0.08, sequence_original[key] / chukunhax.fastspeed) or sequence_original[key]
		end
	end
end

local function sync_meter()
	if not (meter and meter_math) then return end
	if chukunhax.perfectthrow then
		meter.TestAutoTap = meter_math.HalfPeriod() - (0.005 + math.random() * 0.002)
	else
		meter.TestAutoTap = nil
	end
end
undo[#undo + 1] = function() if meter then meter.TestAutoTap = nil end end

local last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()

local function walk_to(pos, tolerance)
	local _, root, hum = character()
	if not root or root.Anchored then return false end
	local flat = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - pos.X, 0, root.Position.Z - pos.Z).Magnitude
	if flat <= tolerance then
		last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()
		return true
	end
	hum:MoveTo(pos)
	if flat < last_distance - 1 then
		last_distance, last_progress = flat, os.clock()
	elseif os.clock() - last_progress > 3 then
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
		last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()
	end
	return false
end

local function throw_target()
	local area = workspace:FindFirstChild("StarterArea")
	if not area then return end
	local line = area:FindFirstChild("CrossLine")
	local z = line and line.Position.Z or area.Position.Z + area.Size.Z / 2
	local _, root = character()
	local x = root and math.clamp(root.Position.X, area.Position.X - area.Size.X / 2 + 3, area.Position.X + area.Size.X / 2 - 3) or area.Position.X
	return Vector3.new(x, area.Position.Y + area.Size.Y / 2 + 3, z - 3)
end

loop(0.35, function()
	sync_meter()
	sync_sequence()
	local _, root = character()
	if not root or not chukunhax.autothrow then return end
	if state and (state.Busy or state.OfflineOpen) or root.Anchored then return end
	local target = throw_target()
	if target then walk_to(target, 1.5) end
end)

scripts.code:
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
local pg = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local uikit = require(RS:WaitForChild("Orchestra"):WaitForChild("UIKit"))

if pg:FindFirstChild("orch_bp_gui") then
	pg.orch_bp_gui:Destroy()
end

local keyMap = {
	["0"] = Enum.KeyCode.Zero, ["1"] = Enum.KeyCode.One, ["2"] = Enum.KeyCode.Two,
	["3"] = Enum.KeyCode.Three, ["4"] = Enum.KeyCode.Four, ["5"] = Enum.KeyCode.Five,
	["6"] = Enum.KeyCode.Six, ["7"] = Enum.KeyCode.Seven, ["8"] = Enum.KeyCode.Eight,
	["9"] = Enum.KeyCode.Nine, ["SPACE"] = Enum.KeyCode.Space, ["SPACEBAR"] = Enum.KeyCode.Space,
	[" "] = Enum.KeyCode.Space, ["LEFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left, ["ARROWLEFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left,
	["←"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left, ["RIGHT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right, ["ARROWRIGHT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right,
	["→"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right, ["UP"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up, ["ARROWUP"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up,
	["↑"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up, ["DOWN"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down, ["ARROWDOWN"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down,
	["↓"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down, [";"] = Enum.KeyCode.Semicolon, ["'"] = Enum.KeyCode.Quote,
	[","] = Enum.KeyCode.Comma, ["."] = Enum.KeyCode.Period, ["/"] = Enum.KeyCode.Slash,
	["\\"] = Enum.KeyCode.BackSlash, ["["] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket, ["]"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket,
	["-"] = Enum.KeyCode.Minus, ["="] = Enum.KeyCode.Equals, ["LSHIFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift,
	["RSHIFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, ["LCTRL"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, ["RCTRL"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
}

local enumList = Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()

local function parseKey(txt)
	if type(txt) ~= "string" then return nil, "?" end
	local s = txt:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if s == "" then return nil, "?" end
	s = s:gsub("^Enum%.KeyCode%.", "")
	local br = s:match("^%[(.-)%]$")
	if br then s = br:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
	local up = s:upper()

	if keyMap[up] then return keyMap[up], s end

	local ok1, e1 = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[s] end)
	if ok1 and typeof(e1) == "EnumItem" then return e1, s end

	local ok2, e2 = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[up] end)
	if ok2 and typeof(e2) == "EnumItem" then return e2, up end

	for _, v in ipairs(enumList) do
		if v.Name:upper() == up then
			return v, v.Name
		end
	end
	return nil, s
end

local function grabKey(rec)
	local k = rec:FindFirstChild("Key")
	local raw
	if k then
		if k:IsA("TextLabel") or k:IsA("TextButton") or k:IsA("TextBox") then
			raw = k.Text
		elseif k:IsA("StringValue") then
			raw = k.Value
		elseif k:IsA("IntValue") or k:IsA("NumberValue") then
			raw = tostring(k.Value)
		end
	end
	if (not raw or raw == "") and rec:GetAttribute("Key") ~= nil then
		raw = tostring(rec:GetAttribute("Key"))
	end
	return parseKey(raw)
end

local hasFire = type(firesignal) == "function"
local hasConns = type(getconnections) == "function"

local function fireSig(sig, ...)
	if hasFire then
		pcall(firesignal, sig, ...)
	elseif hasConns then
		local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, sig)
		if ok and type(list) == "table" then
			for _, c in ipairs(list) do
				if c.Enabled ~= false then
					if type(c.Fire) == "function" then
						pcall(c.Fire, c, ...)
					elseif type(c.Function) == "function" then
						pcall(c.Function, ...)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function gotConns(sig)
	if not hasConns then return false end
	local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, sig)
	return ok and type(list) == "table" and #list > 0
end

local function midOf(b)
	local p, sz = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
	return p.X + sz.X * 0.5, p.Y + sz.Y * 0.5
end

local function pressBtn(b)
	local x, y = midOf(b)
	if not hasFire and not hasConns then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 1) end)
		return
	end
	local sent = false
	if gotConns(b.MouseButton1Down) then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Down, x, y)
		sent = true
	end
	if gotConns(b.InputBegan) then
		fireSig(b.InputBegan, {
			UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
			UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
			Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			Delta = Vector3.zero,
			KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
		}, false)
		sent = true
	end
	if not sent then
		if gotConns(b.Activated) then
			fireSig(b.Activated, {
				UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
				UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
				Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			}, 1)
			sent = true
		elseif gotConns(b.MouseButton1Click) then
			fireSig(b.MouseButton1Click)
			sent = true
		elseif gotConns(b.TouchTap) then
			fireSig(b.TouchTap, { Vector2.new(x, y) })
			sent = true
		end
	end
	if not sent and hasFire then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Down, x, y)
	end
end

local function releaseBtn(b)
	local x, y = midOf(b)
	if not hasFire and not hasConns then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1) end)
		return
	end
	local sent = false
	if gotConns(b.MouseButton1Up) then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Up, x, y)
		sent = true
	end
	if gotConns(b.InputEnded) then
		fireSig(b.InputEnded, {
			UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
			UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.End,
			Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			Delta = Vector3.zero,
			KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
		}, false)
		sent = true
	end
	if not sent and not hasConns and hasFire then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Up, x, y)
	end
end

local on = false
local mode = "Touch"
local off = 0
local hits = 0
local fc = 0

local seen = {}
local tailsHeld = {}
local notesHeld = {}
local relAt = {}
local down = {}

local function rel(idx)
	local d = down[idx]
	if not d then return end
	down[idx] = nil
	if d.m == "Key" and d.k then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, d.k, false, game) end)
	elseif d.m == "Touch" and d.b and d.b.Parent then
		releaseBtn(d.b)
	end
end

local function press(info)
	local idx = info.idx
	if down[idx] then rel(idx) end
	if mode == "Touch" then
		if not info.btn then return false end
		down[idx] = { m = "Touch", b = info.btn }
		pressBtn(info.btn)
		return true
	else
		if not info.key then return false end
		down[idx] = { m = "Key", k = info.key }
		pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, info.key, false, game) end)
		return true
	end
end

local function clearAll()
	for i in pairs(down) do rel(i) end
	table.clear(tailsHeld)
	table.clear(notesHeld)
	table.clear(relAt)
	table.clear(seen)
end

local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
sg.Name = "orch_bp_gui"
sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
sg.DisplayOrder = 999
sg.Parent = pg

local shown = true
local mini = uikit.Button({
	Name = "Mini",
	Kind = "Secondary",
	Icon = "zap",
	Text = "Bot",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(108, 36),
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -16),
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
	Visible = false,
	Parent = sg,
})

local pnl = uikit.Panel({
	Name = "Main",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 320),
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -160),
	Visible = true,
	Parent = sg,
}, {
	uikit.Padding(16, 14),
	uikit.new("UIListLayout", {
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 10),
	}),
})

local hdr = uikit.new("Frame", {
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
	LayoutOrder = 1,
	Parent = pnl,
})

uikit.Text({
	Style = "Eyebrow",
	Text = "ORCHESTRA",
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 14),
	Parent = hdr,
})

uikit.Text({
	Style = "Title",
	Text = "BotPlay",
	TextSize = 20,
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 14),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 26),
	Parent = hdr,
})

local xBtn = uikit.IconButton({
	Icon = "x",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5),
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
	Parent = hdr,
})

do
	local drag, ds, sp = false, nil, nil
	hdr.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			drag = true
			ds = inp.Position
			sp = pnl.Position
		end
	end)
	local c1 = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
		if drag and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local d = inp.Position - ds
			pnl.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + d.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + d.Y)
		end
	end)
	local c2 = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			drag = false
		end
	end)
	sg.Destroying:Connect(function()
		c1:Disconnect()
		c2:Disconnect()
	end)
end

uikit.Rule({ Fleuron = true, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = pnl })

local stLbl
local tabs
tabs = uikit.Tabs({
	Tabs = { "Keys", "Touch" },
	Parent = pnl,
	OnSelect = function(name)
		clearAll()
		mode = if name == "Touch" then "Touch" else "Keys"
		if tabs and tabs.Frame then
			for _, v in ipairs(tabs.Frame:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("TextButton") then
					v.TextColor3 = if v.Name == name then uikit.Colors.Surface else uikit.Colors.TextDim
				end
			end
		end
		if stLbl then stLbl.Text = "Mode: " .. mode end
	end,
})
tabs.Frame.LayoutOrder = 3

local function checkHit(obj, rec)
	local gp, gs = obj.AbsolutePosition, obj.AbsoluteSize
	local rp, rs = rec.AbsolutePosition, rec.AbsoluteSize
	if gs.X <= 1 or gs.Y <= 1 or rs.X <= 1 or rs.Y <= 1 then return false, false end

	local cx = gp.X + gs.X * 0.5
	if cx < rp.X or cx > (rp.X + rs.X) then return false, false end

	local hit = (gp.Y + gs.Y >= rp.Y - off) and (gp.Y <= rp.Y + rs.Y)
	return hit, gs.Y > (rs.Y * 1.6)
end

local function findTail(note, rec, tails)
	local np, ns = note.AbsolutePosition, note.AbsoluteSize
	local nt, nb = np.Y, np.Y + ns.Y
	local rp, rs = rec.AbsolutePosition, rec.AbsoluteSize
	local rl, rr = rp.X, rp.X + rs.X

	local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
	for _, tl in ipairs(tails) do
		if tl.Visible then
			local tp, ts = tl.AbsolutePosition, tl.AbsoluteSize
			if ts.X > 1 and ts.Y > 1 then
				local tx = tp.X + ts.X * 0.5
				if tx >= rl and tx <= rr then
					local tt, tb = tp.Y, tp.Y + ts.Y
					if tb >= (nt - 40) and tt <= (nb + 40) then
						local d = math.abs(tb - nt)
						if d < bestD then
							bestD = d
							best = tl
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getBtn(lane, rec)
	if lane:IsA("GuiButton") then return lane end
	if rec:IsA("GuiButton") then return rec end
	return lane:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or rec:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton")
end

local function scanLanes(hw)
	local out = {}
	for _, ch in ipairs(hw:GetChildren()) do
		local n = ch.Name:match("^Lane(%d+)$")
		if n and ch:IsA("GuiObject") and ch.Visible then
			local rec = ch:FindFirstChild("Receptor")
			if rec and rec:IsA("GuiObject") and rec.Visible then
				local kc, kl = grabKey(rec)
				out[#out + 1] = {
					idx = tonumber(n),
					lane = ch,
					rec = rec,
					btn = getBtn(ch, rec),
					key = kc,
					lbl = kl,
				}
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.idx < b.idx end)
	return out
end

	fc += 1

	for idx, chp in pairs(chips) do
		chp.BackgroundColor3 = if down[idx] then uikit.Colors.Gold else uikit.Colors.Raised
	end

	local og = pg:FindFirstChild("OrchestraGui")
	local hw = og and og:FindFirstChild("Highway")

	if not og or not og.Enabled or not hw or not hw.Visible then
		if on then
			clearAll()
			stLbl.Text = "Status: Waiting for song..."
		end
		return
	end

	local lanes = scanLanes(hw)
	if #lanes == 0 then
		if on then
			clearAll()
			stLbl.Text = "Status: No receptors found"
		end
		return
	end

	syncChips(lanes)
	if not on then return end

	local byIdx = {}
	for _, v in ipairs(lanes) do byIdx[v.idx] = v end

	for idx in pairs(down) do
		if not byIdx[idx] then
			rel(idx)
			tailsHeld[idx] = nil
			notesHeld[idx] = nil
			relAt[idx] = nil
		end
	end

	stLbl.Text = string.format("Running [%s] (%dL)", mode, #lanes)

	for _, v in ipairs(lanes) do
		local i = v.idx
		local ht = tailsHeld[i]
		if ht then
			local t = ht.t
			if not t.Parent or not t.Visible or t.AbsoluteSize.X <= 1 or t.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 1 then
				tailsHeld[i] = nil
				rel(i)
			else
				if checkHit(t, v.rec) then
					ht.inRec = true
				elseif ht.inRec or (fc - ht.sf) > 35 then
					tailsHeld[i] = nil
					rel(i)
				end
			end
		elseif notesHeld[i] then
			local hn = notesHeld[i]
			if not hn.Parent or not hn.Visible then
				notesHeld[i] = nil
				rel(i)
			end
		elseif relAt[i] and fc >= relAt[i] then
			relAt[i] = nil
			rel(i)
		end
	end

	local notes, tails = {}, {}
	for _, ch in ipairs(hw:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("GuiObject") then
			if ch.Name == "Note" then
				notes[#notes + 1] = ch
			elseif ch.Name == "Tail" then
				tails[#tails + 1] = ch
			end
		end
	end

	for _, n in ipairs(notes) do
		if not n.Visible then
			seen[n] = nil
		else
			local any = false
			for _, v in ipairs(lanes) do
				local hit, tall = checkHit(n, v.rec)
				if hit then
					any = true
					if not seen[n] then
						seen[n] = true
						if press(v) then
							hits += 1
							if hitTxt then hitTxt.Text = hits .. " hits" end
							local i = v.idx
							local tl = findTail(n, v.rec, tails)
							if tl then
								tailsHeld[i] = { t = tl, inRec = checkHit(tl, v.rec), sf = fc }
								notesHeld[i] = nil
								relAt[i] = nil
							elseif tall then
								notesHeld[i] = n
								relAt[i] = nil
							else
								relAt[i] = fc + 1
							end
						end
					end
					break
				end
			end
			if not any then
				seen[n] = nil
				for _, v in ipairs(lanes) do
					if notesHeld[v.idx] == n then
						notesHeld[v.idx] = nil
						rel(v.idx)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local visible = false
local animating = false

local function toggleGui()
	if animating then return end
	animating = true
	visible = not visible
	
	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)
	
	TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(false, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = false
	end
end)

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.StretchEnabled then return end
	
	local cfg = getgenv().StretchConfig
	Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
		0, 0, 0,
		1, 0, 0,
		0, cfg.Scale, 0,
		0, 0, 1
	)
end)

task.spawn(optimizeGame)
notify("Screen Stretch • Press P", 3)

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then 
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then 
            Obj.HoldDuration = 0
        end
        for i = 1, Amount do 
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
end

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

-- Função para gerar uma cor aleatória com valores mais altos
local function randomColor()
    return Color3.new(math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255)
end

-- Função para aplicar uma cor suavemente
local function lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
    return startColor:Lerp(endColor, alpha)
end

-- Tempo de transição (em segundos)
local transitionTime = 0.5

-- Remover camisa e calça do jogador
character.Shirt:Destroy()
character.Pants:Destroy()

-- Loop infinito para alterar as cores do corpo
while true do
    local startTime = tick()
    local endTime = startTime + transitionTime
    
    local startColor = randomColor()
    local endColor = randomColor()
    
    while tick() < endTime do
        local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime
        local alpha = elapsedTime / transitionTime
        
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Color = lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
                part.Transparency = 0.25
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- Aqui está a linha que adiciona o material ForceField
            end
        end
        
        wait()
    end
end
   end
})


Section3:Button({
   Text = "Aim",
   Callback = function()
-- Credit Dollynho --

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end
})

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return formatted
end

        end
    end
end)

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false

    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")

            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame

                else

                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function rawlength(tbl)
 local a = 0
 for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
  a = a + 1
 end
 return a
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns2) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)
            return p.format:format(var1, var2, tbl)
        end)
    end
    return code
end

local function SafeOverride(a, b, c) --[[ Index, Data, Should override ]]
    if getgenv()[a] and not c then return 1 end
    getgenv()[a] = b

    return 2
end

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

    if isDragging then

        Object.Position = UDim2.new(

            frameStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
            frameStartPos.Y.Scale,

    end
end
